summary: The Angular 22 workspace, Material/SCSS ordering, local DS components, CVA implementation, axe scan, documentation and immutable-CI integration are in place. The acceptance-test contract is incomplete and the documented theme persistence is not implemented.

findings.summary: Add automated interaction coverage for the required Material coexistence and keyboard/dialog flows.
findings.evidence: apps/angular-example/src/app/app.component.spec.ts has six tests, but none opens/selects a mat-select option, triggers the simulated test and verifies MatDialog open/close with focus restoration, or drives the switch through Space/Enter and verifies focus. The DS-6 plan explicitly requires these behaviors to be covered.

findings.summary: Persist the clear/dark preference in browser storage with a safe non-browser fallback, then cover it.
findings.evidence: AppComponent.toggleTheme() only updates the signal and document class. It neither reads nor writes browser storage, despite the DS-6 plan requiring browser-only persistence with safe SSR/test fallback.
